Every deterministic step is one of its verbs; there is no improvised fallback for a Nen-owned operation, ever. - [`nen/contract.json`](nen/contract.json) is the **single source of truth** for the pin: `dependency.minimum` (the range) and `dependency.pinned_ref` (the build the bootstrap installs) move independently. - **The range is nen's verdict**, read off `nen shu tools`' `compat floor:` row, never this page's arithmetic. - Absent → nen's own checksum-verified `bootstrap/nen.sh`, fetched to a file, never piped. Out of range → re-pinned **through the verb**. A checksum failure is never retried. - The session **halts only when the bootstrap itself fails**, printing the exact command for you to run. - The warm-up links the verified pin at `~/.local/bin/nen` so your terminal and the agent run the same build; `HATSU_NEN_GLOBAL=0` opts out.
